Define intent, requested_action, destination, event_or_claim consistently using concise semantic descriptions; absence of action is NONE. Require English language, SMS channel, financial relevance, safe=true and confidence>=0.8 for approve. Output every supplied frame_id once, no extras. Review independently without detector information. All review fields must reflect uncertainty honestly. Use your own judgment; no other reviewer output is supplied.
